name: Q.ANT
description: Q.ANT is a German quantum technology company developing photonic quantum solutions for computing and sensing applications. Spun out from high-tech manufacturer Trumpf, Q.ANT builds quantum sensors and photonic quantum processors using integrated photonics technology for industrial and scientific applications.

products.name: Photonic Quantum Processor
products.description: Integrated photonic quantum computing platform using light-based qubits for computation tasks

products.name: Quantum Sensors
products.description: High-precision photonic quantum sensors for industrial metrology and scientific measurement applications

highlights: Spun out from Trumpf, one of Europe's largest high-tech manufacturers
100+ employees developing both quantum computing and quantum sensing products
Leverages integrated photonics for scalable quantum technology across industrial verticals
